behaviorDifferences.name: Boat presets and subtype flags
behaviorDifferences.detail: 27 selectors versus15, changed old presets and19 explicit 2010 subtype flags. Standard valid overrides remain length20..50 and displacement/sailArea8..11 before preset-specific replacements.

behaviorDifferences.name: Race-course controls
behaviorDifferences.detail: Downwind-finish commands32992/32993 select layout6/7 at4da188 and enlarged-course flag53527c.32994 toggles gate flag4da1e8, subject to original enable predicates. Named venue selection writes4da1f8; configuration and course routing recompute original geometry.

behaviorDifferences.name: Proximity and penalty conditions
behaviorDifferences.detail: The final Manhattan start-endpoint threshold increases from radius+2 to radius+3.2010 also conditions mark checks on long-course mode, elapsed time and leg/final-leg state. This is separate from tutorial rule-zone wording.

behaviorDifferences.name: Subtype-specific dynamics
behaviorDifferences.detail: Explicit E Scow flag53652c changes heel limit18, heel divisor11, spinnaker threshold97 and multiple power/drag branches. Other new subtype paths and separate true/apparent wind handling require the complete2010 routine rather than an old address adapter.

behaviorDifferences.name: Venue/current integration
behaviorDifferences.detail: 2010 uses venue-aware current sampling and course-dependent coefficient25 or20, with17 for course lengths below2000; original order/spills and integer time/divisor are retained.
